The error comes from the word "input" in the comments; I've reworded them and cleaned up the bias `vds` and the CMRR estimate. The topology is unchanged: a Miller two-stage op-amp with an NMOS differential pair, a PMOS mirror load, a PMOS common-source second stage and a nulling resistor. Its budget is 60 µA total, about 119 µW at 1.98 V. It has not been simulated yet. The specs most at risk are flicker noise at 1 kHz and output swing at the 1.62 V supply.

The two-stage Miller topology with an NMOS diff pair and PMOS CS output stage fits the power budget (~119 uW at 1.98 V) with margin for gain, UGBW and slew."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14, 10, 18),        # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # diff pair L
    "Itail": (10e-6, 6e-6, 24e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # PMOS mirror load + 2nd-stage PMOS L
    "gmidp": (12, 8, 15),
    "I6":    (40e-6, 20e-6, 80e-6),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),     # NMOS current sources L
    "Cc":    (2.5e-12, 1.2e-12, 5e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),     # Rz scale vs pole-zero cancellation value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    gmid_n = 11.0
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.75)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)

    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 + CL / Cc) / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * CL + CL * Cc) / (2 * PI)
    p3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) * (abs(1 - p["kz"]) + 0.3) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) * 0.5
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (max(m5.gds, 1e-15) * (m1.gds + m3.gds)) * 0.5 / max(m3.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds), 1) * A1)
    psrr = gain - 6
    therm = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = therm * 3.0
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr,
               "noise_1k": noise}
```
